title: Usability heuristics: Prioritize usability findings by impact and recurrence, record evidence and map fixes to the user journey rather than subjective visual preference.
description: Design QA lesson for usability heuristics with a reproducible starter defect, instructor repair, offline regression suite and explicit browser and accessibility limits.
objectives: Prioritize usability findings by impact and recurrence, record evidence and map fixes to the user journey rather than subjective visual preference.
Repair the reproducible defect in ui-heuristic-severity.
Identify real user, accessibility or browser QA beyond usability heuristics source tests.
rubric: I can explain the methodology behind usability heuristics.
I can fix the 08.04.04 bug and validate a negative case.
I can name direct accessibility or UX evidence that the source model cannot provide.
